Furthermore, it logs `error.message` on store failure despite the ticket requiring no store detail to be leaked, and it misses the updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`. On the positive side, it dispatches off the per-session lock, uses the composite `{updatedAt, sessionId}` cursor, and takes `userId` from the authenticated session.
